description: This is a Python source file for a chatbot application that integrates various AI services, handles image processing, and manages a pipeline for a WebRTC call, including tool registration and event handling.

classes.name: UrlToImageProcessor
classes.description: A FrameProcessor that extracts image URLs from function call results, fetches the images, and pushes image frames.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes UrlToImageProcessor with an aiohttp session.

methods.name: process_frame
methods.description: Processes a frame, extracts image URL if applicable, and runs image processing.

methods.name: extract_url
methods.description: Extracts image URL from JSON text.

methods.name: run_image_process
methods.description: Fetches image from URL, converts it, and pushes as a frame.

methods.name: run_bot
methods.description: Sets up and runs the main chatbot pipeline with event handlers.

methods.name: bot
methods.description: Main entry point for the bot, creates transport and runs the bot.
